title: Book Two · Chapter 30: A Page for One Reader
story:
On Tuesday, Miss Wu puts the class cards in a folder.

Ronan watches his and Jun's card go inside. The repaired strip is still there. He wants to ask for it, but Miss Wu closes the folder first.

“Can we use the cards again?” he asks.

“Yes. I will keep them here.”

“Will we have the same partners?”

“For some work, perhaps. Later, each person will read a page alone.”

Leo looks up. “A new story?”

“Yes. You will read it, then answer some questions. I will bring the pages another day.”

Ronan looks at Jun. Jun will not point to the lunch note for him. He will need to read the page alone. Then he will answer the questions.

“Will you tell us our places?” he asks.

“Places?”

“First, second, third.”

“I need your answers, not a race. We will talk about the task on that day. Today we have another lesson.”

She writes on the board. Ronan opens his exercise book. He still wants a first place. He wants to read the next story alone. He wants to understand it too.

At break, he asks Leo about Monday.

“Did your story take longer than ours?”

“I do not know.”

“Yours sounded quick.”

“My partner had the short part.”

“Did you understand all of it?”

“We asked each other some questions.”

Leo takes out the cloth ball. “Are you coming?”

“In a moment.”

Ronan wants one more answer, but Leo is already at the door. Jun is there too. Ronan closes his book and joins them.

They play until the bell. Jun misses a catch and laughs at his own hands. The ball comes to Ronan. He catches it low, then sends it back.

On the way home, Ronan stops at Mr Qiu's table. Mum is there to buy thread. Mr Qiu has a small pile of new exercise books beside him.

“Your school book is full already?” he asks Ronan.

“Not yet.”

“Then this one can wait.”

Ronan touches the corner, then takes his hand away. He has empty pages at home. He keeps his coins in his pocket.

Mum holds two small rolls of thread beside a cloth scrap from her bag. One looks right in the shade. She carries it to the edge of the table.

“This one is too pale,” she says.

Ronan looks at the other roll. Mum lays it across the cloth. The colours are much closer.

Mum chooses her thread and pays. They walk home together.

“How was the story yesterday?” she asks.

“We told all of it. Someone asked about the woman.”

“Could you answer?”

“Yes. First I asked, ‘The girl or the woman?’”

“Tell me the question.”

“The child asked, ‘Does she wash it at home?’”

At home, he takes out his copy and shows her. Mum reads the bowl line aloud. Ronan gives the answer again. This time he names the woman and the girl. He does not use she for both.

Then Mum needs the table for her work. Ronan takes the page to his bed.

He can tell the bowl story from the first line to the last. He reads it once more at an easy speed. He reads the word after clearly each time. The girl brings only one apple home.

He puts his copy inside his book. Tomorrow there will be other school work. The new task has no date yet. He opens a different page and begins the first line.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- alone＝独自
- places＝名次、位置（这里指名次）
- in a moment＝一会儿
- understand＝理解、读懂

## 理解问题

1. Ronan仍然在意什么？Miss Wu怎样说明以后的独立任务？
2. 他为什么没有买新练习本？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*He puts his copy inside his book.*

**He / puts his copy / inside his book.**

他／把自己的故事页放好／放进书里。He和his都指Ronan。
